title: Brian Tse on How China Plans to Keep AI Safe - The Wire China
gist: Paywalled Q&A teaser with Brian Tse, founder/CEO of Concordia AI (Beijing/Singapore), on China's approach to AI safety; only his bio is visible. Signals that China has an institutionalized AI-safety governance apparatus (AI Industry Alliance safety committee, World AI Conference advisory roles).

insights.claim: Concordia AI, an AI safety and governance organisation founded in 2020 with offices in Beijing and Singapore, is positioned as a bridge between Chinese and Western AI safety communities.
insights.speaker: Savannah Billman
insights.so_what: Track-two AI safety channels between China and the West may shape eventual global AI regulation affecting frontier labs.
insights.quote: Brian Tse is the founder and chief executive of Concordia AI, an AI safety and governance organisation with offices in Beijing and Singapore.

insights.claim: China's AI Industry Alliance maintains a dedicated safety committee that includes outside expert members such as Brian Tse, indicating formalized industry-level AI safety structures in China.
insights.speaker: Savannah Billman
insights.so_what: Suggests China is building domestic AI safety norms that could become compliance requirements for Chinese AI developers.
insights.quote: He is an AI Governance Advisor to the World AI Conference and an expert member of China’s AI Industry Alliance safety committee.

insights.claim: Brian Tse previously advised the Partnership on AI and consulted with OpenAI before founding Concordia AI, reflecting cross-pollination between U.S. and Chinese AI governance circles.
insights.speaker: Savannah Billman
insights.so_what: Personnel links across U.S.-China AI governance can be a channel for convergence on safety standards despite tech rivalry.
insights.quote: Prior to founding Concordia AI in 2020, he was a senior advisor to the Partnership on AI and consulted with Open AI.

insights.claim: Concordia AI publishes an annual State of AI in China report surveying China's evolving approach to AI safety, a recurring resource for tracking Chinese AI policy.
insights.speaker: Savannah Billman
insights.so_what: A recurring primary source for monitoring Chinese AI regulatory direction.
insights.quote: Concordia publishes an annual report, State of AI in China
